notes.title: A Truly Terrifying World of Tanks Blitz Update
notes.content:
October is set to unleash all sorts of horrors into the night. Nameless terrors that lurk in the depths of the fog, with only mysterious sounds to be heard emanating from the darkness. Sound scary? Well, the scariest is yet to come!


[previewyoutube="W_rDJumqxGM;full"][/previewyoutube]

Infected Front Mode


A new mode sees two powers clash: 10 brave Survivalists against 4 Undead warriors.

The Survivalists' goal is to capture a base at any cost. They must be exceptionally cautious—fallen fighters will respawn and join the ranks of the infected as enemies.

The goal of the Undead is to wipe out the living. They lack thick armor, but their beefed-up speed more than makes up for this. Not to mention their immortality... Think you took one down? No... Infected tanks respawn almost immediately and return to the fight.

Fear is not a word that's in the Survivalists' lexicon. Tenacity in the face of overwhelming odds only releases their hidden power. The fewer they are, the stronger they become: HP and damage increase, reload time decreases.

 

Will the Survivalists stand firm? Or will the Undead infect them all? Rush into battle on October 9 to find out!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b17edc5d1d9c087f7474ddf2d8342ebba13b6585.jpg"]


Damage Indicator


Enjoy full control over every battle! The battle interface has been updated with a dynamic damage indicator showing three key values in real time: Damage Dealt, Assisted Damage, and Damage Blocked.

 

You can switch it on or off in the Settings anytime.


Horrorstadt Will Make You Shudder! 


An evil night descends on Alpenstadt. Evil forces lurk in the darkness... Don't let their silent presence scare you!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0855716a073871a9b5332b496cdb9b517245f79b.jpg"]
The Terrifying Garage


In late October, the Garage will transform and take on sinister colors. Occasionally, the walls glow with terrifying hues as mystical symbols appear. Overhead, the cold moon watches you from the dark skies. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ab6a388dcaaf635ad74e38860abc3403225096af.jpg"]

notes.title: World of Tanks Blitz is getting a fresh update!
notes.content:
Polish TDs


Strong frontal armor, high firepower, and decent mobility—check out the all-new branch of Polish tank destroyers! Here's the line up: SDP 40 Zadymka, SDP 44 Burza, SDP 57 Gowika, SDP 58 Kilana, SDP 60 Gonkiewicza, and dangerous as lightning—NC 70 Błyskawica! They all handle themselves confidently on the frontline and don't shy away from prolonged firefights.


[previewyoutube="s4tEIM2dE4Q;full"][/previewyoutube]


Starting from Tier VIII, these vehicles may surprise you with new firing mechanics: the closer you get to the enemy, the more damage you'll deal! The full potential of these TDs becomes apparent at close range, so don't linger in the bushes—rush into the epicenter of battle with your allies!


Swedish Voiceover


The crews of Swedish vehicles will speak their native language! To hear it, enable the "National Crew Voice" option (Settings → Other) and head into battle in Swedish tanks. Let's roll! Or rather— "utgå!"


Ready for Some Action?


Path of Legends: August 28 – September 24

Watch a special video about our WoT Blitz adventures, pick up a gift, and complete a quest!

 

"One of Three" Event: August 28 – September 30

Collect Pins via different activities to swap for one of three tanks of your choice: FV201 (A45), Škoda T 27, or Kpz. Pr.68 (P).

 

Boosters for Victories: August 28 – September 5

Play European tanks and receive a Cooldown booster for every victory!

 

"Objective: Sheridan Missile" Event: September 12–21

 Show an unearthly level of skill, earn Missiles for your victories and take the legendary Sheridan Missile — a special Collector tank with missiles!

 

Blacksmith Forge Event: September 19–28

Collect Iron Mugs to exchange for resources, containers, and powerful tanks like the unique LKpz.70 K!

 

Blitz Diamond Cup Final

Watch September's official streams covering the most important battles of the tournament and get rewards for being a viewer! All dates and details will be shared in upcoming news articles.

notes.title: Your Gifts From WoT Blitz!
notes.content:
World of Tanks Blitz is turning 11! Another year has flown by in a flash with you! We’ve been upgrading seasonal tanks, battling it out in events, and celebrating every holiday side by side. And guess what? Our birthday’s just around the corner! The party starts now—with gifts already waiting for you in the game! 

[previewyoutube=C8v_o81XKw4;full][/previewyoutube]

How can I claim them?

Enter World of Tanks Blitz from June 5 to July 6, 2025, to receive presents. If you created an account and logged in for the first time before June 1, 2025, you'll find a special container with rewards in your Storage shortly after you enter the game. The longer you've played, the more cool stuff you'll receive. Claim your gifts and spread the word!

notes.title: World of Tanks Blitz Birthday Update
notes.content:
Birthday Activities
Blitz hits another milestone this June, and the party is bigger than ever: unique activities and a heap of gifts await! Thanks for all of your ideas in the comments—some of the best made it into this update!

[previewyoutube=1akw6RD_FsM;full][/previewyoutube]

Seniority Award
Log in from June 5 through July 6 to claim your festive container. The older your account, the bigger the loot inside!

Tanks From the Tutorial
The Type 58, Tiger I, T-34-85, and Sherman Easy 8 are the very first tanks every new player meets in Blitz. We’ve given them a fresh touch and hidden them across various activities. Play this summer to grab them for free! The first one will be available via subscription from June 16 through 23. Don't miss it!

Blitz Fest Event
Get ready for something totally fresh! You’ll have several paths to choose from, each packed with rewards. From June 20 through July 4, explore the paths and earn rewards—including the brand-new Tiger-Maus! Complete any path to get the Bisonte C45 for free!

Tank as a Gift
Log in from June 26 through July 13 to get your hands on the Turbo Collector tank with the Firestorm Legendary camo. Festive customization included!

Maps
You asked—we delivered! For Blitz’s birthday, we’re bringing back some beloved maps:  Lost Temple, Mirage, and Malinovka! Old favorites return, unchanged and unforgettable—just the way we loved them back then ❤️‍🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/1c986b45fb2f63422f02b1ad9222649925744ef4.jpg

New Minimap Design
In battle, quick situational awareness is key—even experienced tankers rely on the Minimap. We’ve updated its design to make it more realistic and easier to read in the heat of battle.

Balance Changes
We've rebalanced 12 Tier VIII–IX vehicles based on your feedback. Some got stronger armor; others now reload faster. Find all the details on our website.

notes.title: Operation "Echo Trace" in World of Tanks Blitz
notes.content:
What makes a good scout? It's the ability to quickly detect the enemy and vanish before they can lock onto you! And, of course, the ability to relay intel to your allies, so there's no one left to target you in the first place.
 
Show your intelligence skills in a new Operation! Fight to claim avatars, war paints, and the A-Signaler Legendary camo for the T-54 ltwt.!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/95dc9aaf70f27767102d10e9f11cea9f868a0c7a.jpg

How to Get Rewards

You'll need a Tier III or higher vehicle to participate.

The Operation includes two reward progression paths, each consisting of 60 levels. The first progression path is available to all regular Pass holders—that means everyone! The second progression path offers more rewards and is only available to Premium Pass holders. To earn rewards, you'll need to increase your Pass level by completing the Operation missions.

Although your Pass Level will increase automatically, you'll need to collect your rewards manually.

What Are the Rewards?

There will be tons of resources, a Collector tank, themed warpaints and avatars, a profile background, certificates that provide XP bonuses for victories, and a Legendary camo for a researchable Tier VIII vehicle!

notes.content:
Ladies and gentlemen!
Let the auction begin—for the first time ever, it's happening right in the game!

This is your chance to expand your collection with rare vehicles at great prices. Don’t miss out—head to the event screen and claim your dream tanks before they are sold out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/3f005e84aaebc9192a714eeeb084fe7ff1c040af.jpg

How Does the Auction Work?

The auction takes place right in the Garage from March 14 through April 17. You can purchase rare Collector and Premium tanks here.

Bidding takes place according to Dutch auction rules: prices decrease, but the number of lots is limited. That means... you snooze, you lose!
New lots open daily. Every 8 hours, the price drops, and after 24 hours, any unsold tanks are removed from the auction to make room for new ones.

notes.title: A-Typical Event in WoT Blitz!
notes.content:
Are you ready for something absolutely aTYPical? From January 10 through January 26, collect Coins for your success in battles and exchange them for rewards. Battle in different vehicle types to make the most of them! Among the rewards, you'll find warpaints, containers with Tier V–VIII Premium vehicles, and the powerful ASTRON Rex.

[previewyoutube=wXzBPi2rWR0;full][/previewyoutube]

Battle in various Tier V–X vehicles to receive 3 types of Coins:

 HT Coins—for playing in heavy tanks.
 L/MT Coins—for playing in light and medium tanks.
 TD Coins—for playing in tank destroyers.

The A-Typical Event has two stages, each with a different method for earning Coins.   

A-Typical Event: Phase 1
Schedule: January 10–18. 
You'll get 1 Coin just for participating in a battle. But if you score a victory, you'll get 3 Coins for playing in V–VII vehicles and 5 Coins for playing in VIII–X vehicles. 

A-Typical Event: Phase 2
Schedule: January 18–26.
You'll get 4 Coins for every battle in Tier V–X vehicles where you deal 1,000 HP of damage or more. 

Exchange Coins for rewards, among which you'll find warpaints, containers with Tier V–VIII Premium vehicles, and the powerful ASTRON Rex!

notes.title: THE EVENT: deadmau5 in the House in World of Tanks Blitz!
notes.content:
Let me grab your attention for a minute… It’s DEADMAU5 IN THE HOUSEEE! For these two weeks only, join the massive party and get the unique chance to experience an icoooonic drop! Please welcome our masked superstar!

[previewyoutube=cSqGPeXBXHA;full][/previewyoutube]

The Party Rules Go Here

To enjoy such a party to the fullest, you need loooads of Vinyls, and you’ll get them by completing missions in Tier IV–X vehicles. For regular missions, you'll get 200 Vinyls, while each additional mission will bring you 350 Vinyls. Every 1,000 Vinyls unlock a party level.

Actually, you can already complete 8 levels of the party, thanks to your hard work during the Secret Show.

Among the rewards, you'll also find Vinyl Boosters, which are installed automatically. With this booster installed, each battle will bring you 1,000 Vinyls regardless of the outcome!

A juicy drop is locked in half of the party levels. You’ll need to collect Vinyls to complete these levels, but to obtain the cool stuff from them, you'll need one of 2 special Passes. So… Do you want more? Then grab your Party Pass and take it all!

Tank'n'Stuff

Two guns to choose from. The Tracer Shells mechanic, unusual for most mediums. And all existing consumables unlocked! I say no more: the mau5tank is a total BANGER. And it’s ready to tear up the dance floor! You just need to unlock it at Level 20.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/9bdcda9f9675805950b98734dafd8c6b4504809b.jpg

Get ready for 60 levels of fun and amaaazing drops! You could claim containers, resources, a bunch of new terrific customization items... And masks!! LOTS of masks! Grab them all and party in style!

notes.title: Secret Show Event in WoT Blitz!
notes.content:
Is it easy to prepare something truly special and upbeat? I mean, like a HUGE holiday party with deadmau5 as a top-tier star on the line up? I tell you what: IT’S NOT EASY! Speaking of… What are your plans for the upcoming few days? Your help will be much appreciated…

[previewyoutube=0eRDc8UW-Mw;full][/previewyoutube]

Don’t worry, nothing extra special—just winning battles, collecting Chill Reagent, and having fun while preparing for even more fun! It’ll be our Secret Show—just for those who really love 5now Globes, tanks, camos, and stuff. Some things for the BIG deadmau5 party are also in the setlist 😉 Fire up the holiday playlist and let’s go!

A46 Different
As soon as you collect enough Chill Reagent and gather all the cool stuff along the way, two headliners will open up to you. The first one is the off-beat badass inspired by the iconic style of deadmau5—A46 Different. This guy hits so different that all your opponents will be stunned! And while they’re recovering, you’ll be able to quickly capture a new audience. Bring the heat!

5now Globe
The second reward is a 5now Globe. Give it a good shake to receive one of 40 excellent vehicles, including our new Tier X medium tank, the Lion! This brawler exerts brute force with its high power-to-weight ratio. It can quickly pump out two shells with its autoloader… and still have another shell in reserve!

When will we hold our Secret Show?

Europe: December 2, 13:00 (CET) to December 16, 13:00 (CET)
North America: December 2, 05:00 (PT) / 08:00 (ET) to December 16, 05:00 (PT) / 08:00 (ET)

notes.title: Operation The Last Winter in WoT Blitz
notes.content:
It was truly a legendary winter. Years of hard scientific work had finally yielded fruit: a revolutionary power source called the Cryotainer. The only thing left to do was unveil it to the excited world. Now, scientists have all gathered for the grand conference. They wipe away tears as they deliver speeches, bestow rewards, and celebrate this great discovery that is about to change the world. No one knows that this winter will be the last... But that's all in the future. For now, it's time for speeches and celebrations! Join the party and win a ton of rewards, including the Poinsettia legendary camo for the Progetto CC55 mod. 54!

[previewyoutube=7sY3h3ZGKj0;full][/previewyoutube]

How to Get Rewards

You will need a Tier III vehicle or higher to participate.

The Operation includes two reward progression paths, each consisting of 60 levels. The first progression path is available to all regular Pass holders—meaning everyone! The second progression path offers more rewards and is only available to Premium Pass holders. To earn rewards, you'll need to increase your Pass Level by completing the Operation missions.

Although your Pass Level will increase automatically, you'll need to collect your rewards manually.

What Are the Rewards?

There will be tons of resources, a Collector tank, themed warpaints and avatars, a profile background, certificates that provide XP bonuses for victories, and a legendary camo for a researchable Tier VIII vehicle!

notes.title: Black Friday in WoT Blitz!
notes.content:
It's time for the sales we've all been waiting for! From November 15 through 30, dozens of great offers with state-of-the-art vehicles await! Plus heaps of bonuses!

[previewyoutube=O-bQFf_87qU;full][/previewyoutube]

How Can I Get My Hands on Them?

To grab the bonuses, you'll need Coupons, and you can get these from bundles with the “Coupons inside!” label. You can exchange them for a ton of containers and the most advanced vehicles on the market: the steadfast SMV Vipera, dangerous Lorraine 50 t, and new 116-F3—a heavy with high single-shot damage and solid armor!

notes.title: Operation Ivory Tower in World of Tanks Blitz
notes.content:
Act quickly: These high-tech hackers are as fast as light! Ilaina Kitt will do anything to fend off attacks against her technological empire, and your contribution will make a difference! You'll be rewarded for your part: avatars, resources, and the Omnitron Legendary camo for the Panther II await! Let's get to it!

[previewyoutube=2NSDd1nAqsI;full][/previewyoutube]

How Can I Get the Rewards?

You need a Tier III or higher vehicle to participate. 

The Operation includes two reward progression paths, each comprising 60 levels. The first progression path is available to all regular Pass holders—meaning everyone! The second progression path offers more rewards and is only available to Premium Pass holders. To receive rewards, increase your Pass level by completing the Operation missions.

notes.title: The Vortex of Souls Event
notes.content:
When the ghostly moon shines its dim light on a world frozen in terror, the spawn of darkness awaken from their slumber. The most terrifying of them is the Souleater, which ensnares the souls of heroes and imprisons them in Lanterns used for witchcraft rituals. Is there any hope? Yes! How can we rid the world of this evil? By fighting!

[previewyoutube=fqvGPcgGaws;full][/previewyoutube]

Farm Lanterns in battle to set heroes' souls free and summon the fearless Lightbringer. Defeat the Souleater, and you'll be remembered forever for your deeds. You'll also get a heap of rewards!

Rewards

60 levels stretching into infinity await you with countless rewards!

Among them is the new Tier VII heavy Lightbringer, the Wyvern Scalemail camouflage, collectible items, a profile background, and Wicked Souls Containers that may drop the powerful Souleater.

notes.title: Operation Bard's Song in WoT Blitz
notes.content:
Hey, you! Yes, you. Do you seek fame, glory, and the chance to make a quick buck? Well, listen up, because there are piles of rewards in the nearby dungeon, just waiting to be looted. Resources, war paints, avatars... I'm gathering a party of daredevils for the raid. Join us, and one day people will tell tales of our legendary feats! We need one more brave fighter who doesn't fear the fire-breathing beast guarding the dungeon. Oh, I haven't mentioned the beast, have I? Well, there is some risk involved in this adventure. But it will be worth it. After all, we'll be leaving the dungeon with tons of loot—like the Bard Legendary camo for the M-III-Yoh!

[previewyoutube=1QywDp3p9Fs;full][/previewyoutube]

How to Get Rewards

You will need a Tier III vehicle or higher to participate. 

The Operation includes two reward progression paths, each consisting of 60 levels. The first progression path is available to all regular Pass holders—that is, all players. The second progression path offers more rewards and is only available to Premium Pass holders. To earn rewards, you'll need to increase your Pass Level by completing the Operation missions.

Although your Pass Level will increase automatically, you'll need to collect your rewards manually. 

What Are the Rewards?

There will be tons of resources, a Collector tank, themed war paints and avatars, a profile background, certificates that provide XP bonuses for victories, and a legendary camo for a researchable Tier VIII vehicle!

notes.title: Season 5: Legends Update
notes.content:
Season 5: Legends
Embark on a search for legends alongside outstanding explorers! Three months of unforgettable adventures await with cool rewards for the taking—Power Cells are among them! Use them to restore unique tanks and touch true legends!

[previewyoutube=Mdp5tdAKzRk;full][/previewyoutube]

French Medium Tanks 
Four agile French vehicles are available to research! High speed and a two-shell magazine are among the strengths of this branch. A perfect combo for scouts!

And the powerful Projet Murat is on top. It takes this Tier X tank less than 3 seconds to deal 740 damage! Avoid enemy return fire by maneuvering and changing position in a flash. Once the magazine has reloaded—attack!

10 vs. 10 Mode
Looking to ramp up the action? Head this way! The rules are simple: clear the map of 10 enemy tanks to lead your team to victory. Develop new battle strategies and deal even more damage to have ultimate fun!

Crew Mastery
An experienced crew is the key to success in battle! That's why all tanks are going to come with 100% trained crew right after purchase! You won't have to spend credits and gold on crew training, and upgrading skills has become easier as well.

Balance Changes 
This update ushers in new ways of playing for Tier X tanks. The main purpose of this round of rebalancing is to brush up the gameplay of familiar vehicles and beef up the advantages of less popular war machines.

More Details

notes.title: A-Typical Event in WoT Blitz!
notes.content:
Are you ready for something absolutely aTYPical? From September 3 through September 24, collect Coins both for participating in battles and for winning them! Coins are a special currency that can be exchanged for valuable rewards. Battle in different types of vehicles to make the most of them! 

[previewyoutube=Fol_5ZAiVe4;full][/previewyoutube]

Rewards

Battle in various Tier V–X vehicles to receive 3 types of Coins:

 HT Coins—for playing in heavy tanks.
 L/MT Coins—for playing in light and medium tanks.
 TD Coins—for playing in tank destroyers.

You'll get 1 Coin just for participating in a battle. But if you score a victory, you'll get 3 Coins for playing in V–VII vehicles and 5 Coins for playing VIII–X vehicles. 

Exchange them for rewards, among which you'll find warpaints, containers with Tier V–VIII Premium vehicles, and the mighty Škoda T 56 heavy tank!

notes.title: Season 1 Tanks Are Returning!
notes.content:
Progresston isn't just a utopian city where science and technology flourish. You might remember it as the setting of Season 1, where many tried and couldn't manage to claim and upgrade all the available tanks... But don't worry! It's time to wipe those bad memories away, because Retrotopia tanks are making a comeback!

Are the Season 1 tanks available again?

Oh, yes they are! You can find them in the in-game Store until October 1. Grab Magnate, Fixer, and Regressor separately or together in one bundle. We've even added enough Kitcoins to help you pump up all the missing modules. Claim the tanks from Season 1: Retrotopia, upgrade them to perfection, and roll out!

notes.title: Operation "You Only Shoot Twice" in WoT Blitz
notes.content:
Genius and madness are separated by just one thing: success! Dive into an adventure story where the villain is deviously clever and the hero stuns with his professionalism. Get to the heart of a spy network to obtain the unrivaled Aerial Legendary camouflage for the AMX 13 90!

[previewyoutube=_hU-aCCjPtA;full][/previewyoutube]

You need a Tier III or higher vehicle to participate. 

The Operation includes two reward progression paths, each comprising 60 levels. The first progression path is available to all players as regular Pass holders. The second progression path offers more rewards and is only available to Premium Pass holders. To receive rewards, increase your Pass Level by completing the Operation's missions.

Tons of resources, a Collector tank, themed warpaints and avatars, a profile background, certificates that provide XP bonuses for victories, and a Legendary camo for a researchable Tier VIII vehicle!

notes.title: Burning Gears Festival
notes.content:
Someone's banging on the door of your rock-star trailer. It's time for you to take the stage. Put on your most stylish outfit, crank the speakers up to max, and become the headliner of Burning Gears—this summer's greatest music festival! Put on a top-notch performance for the Wastelanders, peppered with killer guitar riffs and a crazy fire show! Party like it's the end of everything, get rewards for victories, and farm prizes from Music Cases and Fan Mailboxes along the way. Sand Globes can drop you literally the most powerful rewards! Let the show begin!

[previewyoutube=NnDCK0xLNS4;full][/previewyoutube]

Win in Tier IV–X vehicles! Each victory will earn you 2 Festival Tickets. Use them to complete event stages and receive rewards!

Rewards

Complete all the event stages to unlock access to the main reward—a Sand Globe. Shake it well and crack it open to find a Massive Container with resources; customization; and best of all—Tier VIII–X Collector or Premium vehicles, such as the Type 5 Ka-Ri, BZ-58-2, Progetto 46, XM66F, and 114 SP2! Damn, what a catch!

Rewards also await you in Music Cases and Fan Mailboxes. You can open them as many times as you wish! Pay for the first with Free XP; the second—with gold. You may find a Sand Globe inside!

notes.title: Flea Market Event
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=raDyXrBNrwg;full][/previewyoutube]
There's food for every kind of fish in this pond! The small ones and the big ones. What's that pond, you might ask? Yeah, not the best comparison when we're actually in a desert. Imagine a treasure island then! Oops, that's kinda about water too... It's really a VAST land of wonders where everyone can find their treasure: resources, camouflage, daring vehicles, and more! And you can always expect to get some free stuff, too!

How Can I Get What's Mine?

Well, you'll need to grab Can-Openers. Get them in the Store! Use them to open Metal Barrels that can drop containers, vehicles, Legendary camos, certificates for x5 XP, Free XP, a unique avatar, and the Rammer, a new Tier VII tank.

What Free Stuff?

We just wanted to share some little treats with our dear customers... Visit the Store to claim yours! It'll equip you with everything you need for your journey across the land of wonders, including a Can-Opener. We're at your service!

notes.content:
World of Tanks Blitz is turning 10! A DECADE! Incredible! We can hardly believe it! Time flies... But it's been great spending it with you in WoT Blitz! We've been side by side in victory and defeat, sometimes among the top damage dealers and sometimes falling a bit lower. Now, let's celebrate the way we do best—with gifts!

notes.title: Operation "Welcome to Regresston!" in WoT Blitz
notes.content:
This place doesn't feel like Progresston anymore, that's for sure... But life here is certainly vibrant! It seems like every man of science came together to restore the city its former glory. Those weirdos are definitely not ready to accept the collapse of Progresston...
 
Oh, just look at this landscape! How epic would it be to drive through the sands among the islands of metal ve... Wait, what's that? THE REGRESSOR?! Is it just us, or did the local mechanics really overdo it this time?.. Holy crap, is that thing driving right at us?! Please don't tell me we have to fight it! Although... It seems like there are things worth fighting for! If we win, everyone gets avatars, resources, and the Speedfire Legendary camo for the M26 Pershing. Are you in? Then let's roll!

[previewyoutube=C2mUrrGHZy8;full]YOUTUBE LINK[/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Objective: Sheridan Missile
notes.content:
— We're in outer space! What are the orders, Commander? 
— To win!

[previewyoutube=SO2-vIp7u94;full][/previewyoutube]

Rush into battle at cosmic velocity and collect Missiles for each victory! Exchange them for Screens, valuable resources, a Remote Control for your Garage Screen, the Pz.Kpfw. IV Schmalturm Tier VI Premium tank in a Legendary camo (-o-), and the Explorer Tier VI Collector tank.

Show us your out-of-this-world level of mastery, complete all stages, and get the legendary Sheridan Missile or Mighty Haul!

How Can I Claim All the Rewards?

It's very simple: win battles!

In any tank, you'll get 2 Missiles for each victory in regular and rating battles, and 3 Missiles for each victory in fun modes. But if you fight in the Sheridan Missile in fun modes, you'll get 4 Missiles! Exchange them for prizes on the event screen!

notes.title: The High Voltage Quest and TSL-7 Defender
notes.content:
The TSL-7 Defender is the latest tank to be commissioned by the Defenders Corporation—and designed by a mysterious genius engineer. The tank boasts an electric engine, low silhouette, decent frontal armor, and of course, a gun with impressive damage per minute and a 3-shell magazine. Get it now from the containers or complete the High Voltage Quest for your chance to add it to your Garage for free!

[previewyoutube=Ovg_Hff339s;full][/previewyoutube]

Containers offering the chance to claim the TSL-7 Defender and other rewards will be available from the Store until July 22.

High Voltage Quest

Enter the game from July 8 through 18 to unlock your quest, which will consist of 10 stages. Then, progress through the stages by dealing as much damage as possible in battles. As you complete the stages, you'll be able to claim impressive rewards, including Screens, attachments, and vehicles from the Y5 series. But most importantly, you'll score a TSL-7 Defender Container, offering the chance to get a new vehicle!

The quest you receive will depend on your in-game activity over recent months.

notes.title: Operation Into the Unknown
notes.content:
Space, the final frontier...

Stardate 2266.183. The U.S.S. Enterprise has discovered an odd-looking pyramid on an unexplored Class M planet. However, after landing on the planet's surface, the away team quickly determines that the pyramid is not what it seems! In fact, it's just a small part of an enormous starship that has moved almost entirely underground over the past centuries. This cube-shaped starship belongs to the mysterious Borg Collective. And they're not very happy to see unexpected guests!

[previewyoutube=-6D_HGZ9_MA;full][/previewyoutube]

Join the Operation Into the Unknown, find a way out of this hopeless situation, and earn piles of resources, warpaints, avatars, and the Borg Drone Legendary camo for the Spähpanzer Ru 251!

notes.content:
Welcome! This is a heavenly place, isn't it? Perfect for a birthday celebration in the family circle. It has everything you need: refreshing sea, juicy fruit, and... terrific tanks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/23f2ff42e8502e50c8131e8ffe0554e11a4d35aa.jpg

New Heavy Tank BZ-58-2

notes.title: Season 4: Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Season 4: Anniversary

This time, it's more than just a seasonal event with a beautiful story. For three months, we'll be broadcasting a whole spectrum of fun to you! So prepare for the most vibrant and intense summer in the game's history! And remember: if there's a screen, there's Blitz 😉

[previewyoutube=MPA5DJhsGKI;full][/previewyoutube]

"What If?..." Tank Progression

You'll find a chain of stages with rewards on the Season's main screen. These are three unique Tier VII, VIII, and IX tanks with a myriad of upgrades. Each tank will be assembled in the Garage based on the resources you receive during the campaign.

The E-10, DTH-STR, and KV-JR... Vehicles that look oh-so-familiar, and that's no accident! We've selected players' favorite tanks and imagined how they could perform at another tier.

Italian Heavy Tanks

The Italian vehicle branch just got a boost with four new heavies. These swift sharpshooters are perfect for second-line combat. The Tier VII Carro d'assalto P.88 shines with its standard gun and quick reload. Meanwhile, the Tier VIII Progetto CC55 mod. 54 and Tier IX Progetto C50 mod. 66 feature a two-shell magazine that lets them deal hefty damage in mere seconds.

At the top of the branch is the powerful Rinoceronte equipped with a two-shell gun. Mobile and accurate, with a comfortable gun and armored turret, this heavy can take down enemies in a flash! But be warned: When using your turret armor, keep moving to make it even harder for enemies to hit your vulnerable spots.

More Details

notes.title: Hot Pursuit Event
notes.content:
In this town, you have to keep an eye out! We weren't vigilant enough... Our latest top-secret design is about to hit the black market. Help us get it back! The rewards for your efforts will be worth it!

[previewyoutube=W3miMmka2Bk;full][/previewyoutube]

When Shall I Set Off?

Set off on a pursuit right now and win battles! Each victory in a Tier V–X vehicle will earn you 2 Flags. Another 2 Flags will be added for a Mastery Badge of Class II or higher. Use Flags to complete stages of the first part of the event and get rewards! To enjoy even more prizes, get bundles with gold. Each bundle will bring you Shells that will enrich you with resources, the Urban Pulse Epic camo, a "Collect 'Em All!" container, a unique profile background, a unique avatar, and a Coupon. Exchange the Coupon for the WZ-111, Titan-54d, or T77!

notes.content:
Here's a job for a truly tough clan! What's the deal? Show your skills on the battlefield and get an amazing new vehicle as a reward! 

Join the Clan Challenge event from May 6 through 27! The rules are simple: complete clan missions and a special quest to earn Clan Tickets. notes.title: Operation Cowabunga!
notes.content:
Hey Shredder, why the long face? "Operation Cowabunga!" is nowhere near the crest of the wave that it's set to make!

Hop into your favorite vehicle, and let's chase down the insidious villain together! Awesome rewards await you at every turn—including resources, warpaints, avatars, a bodacious profile background, and the Shredder Legendary camo for the P.44 Pantera. Cowabunga!

[previewyoutube=b_WVwKQJ3zg;full][/previewyoutube]

How Can I Get the Rewards?

You need a Tier III or higher vehicle to participate. 

The Operation includes two reward progression paths, each comprising 60 levels. The first progression path is available to all players as regular Pass holders. The second progression path offers more rewards and is only available to Premium Pass holders. To receive rewards, increase your Pass Level by completing the Operation's missions.

While the Pass Level increases automatically, you'll need to collect your rewards manually. 

What Are the Rewards?

Tons of resources, a Collector tank, themed warpaints and avatars, a profile background, certificates that provide XP bonuses for victories, and a Legendary camo for a researchable Tier VIII vehicle!

notes.title: The "Into the Sewers!" Event
notes.content:
New Bay has always been a troubled city. Only the bravest dare to drive down its dangerous streets, where enemy tanks, armed to the commander's cupola, can drive around the corner at any moment! But now, things have gotten even worse: evil forces of the likes we've never faced before have emerged in the city...

We need a team of professional fighters to deal with this mess, warriors who are familiar with this new enemy. With the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles fighting alongside us, this menace will be defeated in no time! But hurry up—you need to start preparing for the battles ahead. That's why we're here now, in the Turtles' hideout!

[previewyoutube=GcTVGcoQkc0;full]YOUTUBE[/previewyoutube]

How can I get the rewards?

Just win! Fight regular or rating battles, or fight in fun modes in Tier IV–X vehicles and earn Pizza for your first 5 victories of the day. Use Pizza to complete the event stages and claim cool rewards, including a themed profile background, camouflage, Garage Gear, and an avatar.

When does the "Into the Sewers!" event take place?

To take part in the event, enter the game during this period:

 Europe: From April 24, 14:00 (CEST) until May 24, 14:00 (CEST).
 North America: From April 24, 06:00 (PT) / 09:00 (ET) until May 24, 06:00 (PT) / 09:00 (ET).
 APAC: From April 24, 14:00 (UTC+8) until May 24, 14:00 (UTC+8).

After that, you'll have precisely 7 days to complete the event stages.

notes.title: The Hunt Is On: Grab the Tiger 131 or AMX CDA 105!
notes.content:
You'll need all your skills! This is your main weapon in the hunt for one of two targets: the strong Tiger 131 or penetrating AMX CDA 105. Off we go!

[previewyoutube=zbrLRUjCxOA;full]YOUTUBE[/previewyoutube]

What's the task?

To deal damage! From April 12 through 22, enter the game to unlock one of two quests, each consisting of six stages. Deal as much damage in battles as you can to complete them! If you complete all the stages, you'll get 750 Snippets and one of the two vehicles, depending on the quest: the Tiger 131 or AMX CDA 105.

Which quest you get depends on your in-game activity in recent months.

Break through the enemy defences in the impressive Tiger 131 or send your enemies one after another back to the Garage in the penetrating AMX CDA 105! Use Snippets to upgrade the tanks of this Season's progression!

notes.title: The Xenobarrier Event
notes.content:
Welcome to the field HQ, commander! Everyone's crazy busy right now—from privates to generals. A couple of hours ago, we received intel that the xenotanks have altered their strategy: they're activating protective energy field units near the portal. Our engineers have dubbed them Beacons. These energy fields are popping up like mushrooms after a spring rain. We need to hit them before they've covered the whole valley with their impenetrable shield. Roll out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/73d1b8f73f06f23c1a32a8af2f7093a3ba774769.jpg

How do you get the rewards?

Play regular or rating battles or temporary modes in Tier IV–X vehicles and get 5 Beacons for the first victory of the day! Every consecutive victory on that day will bring you 1 more Beacon. 

Use Beacons to complete stages of the event and grab rewards that include the Plasma Grid camouflage, the Whirly Bird Attachment, and the Xenobarrier Profile Background.

More Details

notes.content:
The story of the Resistance has reached the point of no return. This month, you and your allies will decide how it all ends. Fight against the sinister CORE and earn rewards! Resources, warpaints, avatars of various characters, and the Imposter Legendary camouflage for the Rhm.-B. WT await you!

[previewyoutube=V0HA46Y3PaM;full]YOUTUBE[/previewyoutube]

You need a Tier III vehicle or higher to participate.

The lower progression with more rewards is only available to Premium Pass owners. To receive rewards, increase your Pass Level by completing the Operation's missions.

There will be tons of resources, a Collector tank, themed war paints and avatars, a profile background, certificates for XP bonuses for victories, and a legendary camo for a researchable Tier VIII vehicle!

notes.title: Get the Strv 74A2!
notes.content:
What Should I Do?

Enter the game 10 days in a row and grab 10 parts of a certificate for the Strv 74A2 daily, along with certificates for x3 XP, credits, boosters, Free XP, and war paints! Don't miss a single day of the 10-day span to collect 100 parts of the certificate, combine them in your Storage, and get hold of this Hybrid Nation Premium tank!

Important! Parts of the certificate are not credited for days missed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b0609eead89a7d9de2986477a69669e3dbb74f62.jpg

What's the Tank Like?

The Strv 74A2 is a fast and dangerous Swedish predator. Its key feature is a gun with a three-shell magazine—just what you need to blow your enemies to smithereens in a heartbeat!

Be cold-blooded. Watch your prey. Crush it with three accurate shots within 4 seconds. And while the gun is reloading, change your position to attack again!

Subscription Available

To get the subscription, enter the game on:

notes.title: Turning the Tide Event
notes.content:
It was only yesterday that the Resistance fighters seemed strong enough to have secured the valley, but fate has reminded us that victory always rests on a knife edge. Today, the evil portal has been reactivated, and it's already unleashing an endless wave of xenotanks from its gaping maw. Let them come! We are ready. A special welcome has been prepared for them: the most experienced commanders in time-tested Elefant tank destroyers are gearing up to bring the hostile surge to a halt and do a little bit of terraforming while they are at it.

You'll find Snippets among the spoils of war. You can use these to upgrade the unique vehicles of Season 3: Resistance! 

[previewyoutube=vE9CSuL6jFE;full][/previewyoutube]

Mastery Respected

Fight in Tier IV–X vehicles, earn Mastery Badges, and obtain Mastery Emblems:

 Ace Tanker:  15
 Class I:  7

Use Mastery Emblems to complete stages of the event and claim rewards: XP and Gold boosters, certificates for x3 XP, the Deep Scars Epic animated camouflage, and... Detonators! You can exchange Detonators for The XenoEye Animated Avatar, The Elefant Enduring and Elefant Container!

notes.content:

Just play?

notes.content:
Mrs. Anderson is the sweetest old lady in the whole world. But don't you dare break her fence, or even worse, crush the flowers in her lovely garden! In that case, you're on your own—this lady won't let you get away with it. And even hordes of bloodthirsty vehicles don't terrify her!

Join Operation Neighborhood Watch and kick the hostile invaders out of our quiet alpine town. You'll receive valuable rewards—avatars, camouflage, resources, and the Handmade Legendary camouflage for the CS-53!

Resources, camos, containers, vehicles, a unique profile background, avatars, and a Garage Gear—all of these could be yours. Collect Fireworks and Goldfish and exchange them for rewards!

notes.title: Season 3: Resistance update
notes.content:
Season 3: Resistance
The main event will take place somewhere in the alpine meadows, and unfold with an epic battle scene. The best commanders of different nations will unite to stop an unknown enemy and determine the fate of humanity.

Resistance will last three months. There are many battles and challenges ahead, during which you'll collect enough Snippets to build three unique tanks!

[previewyoutube=i-jAwn_UgRU;full][/previewyoutube]

Chinese heavy tanks
Four new heavy tanks in the Chinese Tech Tree! Tier VII and VIII tanks are well-armored and strike hard. The Tier IX BZ-68 is just like them, and also boasts impressive speed for a heavy tank. The Tier X BZ-75 has all the advantages of these three, but with an even better armored hull. Besides that, higher-tier tanks are equipped with alternative guns with high single-shot damage and average accuracy.

New sounds
Improved hit sound in both Arcade and Sniper Modes. Ricochet will also get its own sound.

Balance Changes
This time, Tier IX tanks will have balance improvements. They're dedicated to freshening up your gaming experience with 22 vehicles. Some of them received an armor upgrade.

Camouflage Rotation
The Spooky for the Kpz RH, Baba-Yaga for the IS-7, Terrifying for the Chimera, and Wavebreaker for the XM551 Sheridan are now available in the camo selection menu.

MORE DETAILS

notes.content:

To WoT Blitz's Discord!

And now it's time to roll out into the game at full speed, complete the Quest, and grab the powerful T67 tank destroyer!

Reward: Customization Container

notes.content:

notes.title: The Predatory Strv 81
notes.content:
You can't run... And you can't hide... Like a predatory beast, the Strv 81 is fast and maneuverable, moving nimbly across the map, stalking its prey, searching for vulnerable points in the defenses, and then delivering a devastating blow! Don't even try to run from it—a flurry of shells from its high-speed gun with decent damage will inevitably catch up with you.

Take command of the predatory Strv 81, and let the hunt begin!

Containers that may include the Strv 81 or other rewards will be available in the Store until February 2.

Kämpe Legendary Camouflage

notes.title: Garage Party Event
notes.content:
We're thrilled to anounce a big Garage party! Only our friends are invited, and you're one of them, of course! So, what's on the plate? Containers with cool rewards, attachments, camouflage, resources, avatar, a profile background, and new tanks! 

[previewyoutube=gMUPsKHKbbM;full][/previewyoutube]

How do you get to the party?

You're gonna need Party Keys. Get them in the Store! Use Party Keys to open Party Boxes. Inside, you may find containers, vehicles, legendary camouflage, x5 XP certificates, Free XP, days of Premium Account, an avatar, and a new Tier VIII tank—the FV1066 Senlac.

And that's not all! Every Party Box drops Gold, Disco Balls, Party Hats, and Gala Key Charms guaranteed (if you're lucky, you may even find a Gala Key right away!). They will earn you even more prizes! Including camouflage, an attachment, a profile background, and TWO new Tier VIII tanks—the Kpz. Pr.68 (P) and ST-62 Ver. 2.

MORE DETAILS

notes.title: Souvenir Store Event
notes.content:
The cozily decorated window of the Souvenir Store showcases the glimmering trophies that all look so familiar...These are rewards that mark your achievements as the year's wrapping up! And here's a fully functional Souvenir Machine that drops rewards for victories.

[previewyoutube=2lnHNm6E50c;full][/previewyoutube]

But let's not forget the main thing 😊

Happy holidays, tanker! Thanks for being with us throughout this year. Together we researched new tanks, played in fun modes, set off on adventures in Seasons, fought for good ratings, and watched tournament streams counting the Keys that came with them. Take a look back: you won big so many times! But sweet victories don’t come without bitter defeats, right? The future holds even more emotional moments. We'll make sure they're as bright and exciting as they can be. 

We wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
Roll out! 

Your WoT Blitz 💛

Let's go back to the Souvenir Store

The Souvenir Machine drops rewards for Tokens. What can you get? First and foremost, a Small Gold Charm. What else? For example, the Booming Party animated camo. Or the merry Holiday Magic attachment that will keep you in high spirits. Or one of these tanks: the M3 Light, Locust, T-127, Pz. II J, or T-15.

MORE DETAILS

notes.title: Winter Fair Event
notes.content:
The northern town warmly welcomes our heroes with a holiday fair! Now is the perfect moment to rest after a long journey, enjoy the atmosphere, and try your chances of winning all kinds of prizes at the attractions! There are Snow Globes standing in straight rows, and Boxes of Presents too! Let the fun begin!

[previewyoutube=KPTvJKHASUA;full][/previewyoutube]

Win in Tier IV–X vehicles! Each victory will earn you 2 Fair Tickets. Use them to complete event stages and receive rewards!

Rewards

Complete all of the event's stages to unlock access to the two main rewards. The first is the Chrysler K. At first glance, a turret shifted to the rear of the hull makes it clear that the vehicle is particularly well-suited for urban map battles. It boasts reliable frontal armor, a sturdy turret that easily deflects shells, a fast-firing gun, and unexpectedly good dynamics for such a steel monster. The crushing power of this colossus is highlighted by the Vanguard attachment.

The second is a Snow Globe. Give it a good shake and grab a powerful Tier VII–X vehicle. And if you're lucky, you might even get the shiny XM66F, a new Tier X!

Boxes of Presents have something for you as well. You can open them as many times as you wish! Pay for the first with Free XP and with gold for the other. You may find a Snow Globe inside!

MORE DETAILS

notes.title: Holiday Ops 2024
notes.content:

notes.title: Season 2: Constellation Update
notes.content:
Join the adventurers and lead them through the Season—a dangerous and exciting 3-month-long challenge that will bring you rewards. Together you will solve the mystery of the Swamp Monster and collect enough Fortium Shards to build three unique vehicles!

[previewyoutube=_MA90PvURrw;full][/previewyoutube]

It is a large-scale update of the game that includes new vehicles, balance changes, and fresh content. All in-game elements are designed to immerse you in a new story, from the Garage to the camos, the Orders, and the bundles in the Store.

Polish Medium Tanks

Please welcome the newbies in the Tech Tree of the European Nation: six medium tanks flying the Polish colors! Their advantages are speed, dynamics, and great firepower!

Updated Platoon Interface

Now your Garage looks different once you have created a platoon or accepted an invitation to join one. The camera will travel outside to show two tanks: yours and your platoon mate's. The looks of your mate's tank are updated in real-time and show the applied modules, attachment, and camo.

Updated Quick Commands

We are working hard to improve the quick commands wheel to make it more useful and easier to understand in order to enhance coordination in battle. New commands are displayed in your battle chat, in the minimap, and on the battle screen.

The Hold position! command has been replaced with Moving here! Hover the camera's marker over a point on the landscape, or an allied or enemy tank, and press this command to let your allies see the marker on the minimap and the main battle screen. Yes! They will see exactly the hill or building the camera was pointed at!

Maps

This Season's rotation will not include:
• Mayan Ruins
• Winter Malinovka
• Black Goldville
• Fort Despair
• Dead Rail

And these are making their comeback!
• Vineyards
• Dynasty's Pearl
• Copperfield
• Port Bay
• Ghost Factory

Balance Changes

We've changed a lot! We've updated the characteristics of 88 vehicles, which include 61 Tier X tanks. The goal is not only to increase the effectiveness of the tanks which can't boast great stats, but also to revamp the gameplay of the usual vehicles. Some tanks will noticeably strengthen their principal characteristics, while others will change their role in gameplay.

Quick and smooth teamwork is what it takes to KEEP CALM AND WIN epic victories. It's high time to improve our quick commands. The first step is to update the way they look and how they are sent. Icons have become clearer while the commands are now grouped more logically. These updates have resulted in faster team coordination.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/30273907a03bb89ca450f9016b432dd187999304.jpg
On touch devices

 Place the quick commands wheel button on the screen where it's best for you.
 Tap once on the quick commands wheel button to send the "Attack!" command.
 Aim at a specific tank and tap once on the quick commands wheel button to let your allies know that you are going to attack this target.
 Tap and hold the quick commands wheel button, then select an icon you need to send out any other command.
On PC

 Click the quick commands wheel button and move your mouse as needed to send out quick commands. Forget about hot keys. 😉
 You can also send quick commands the old-fashioned way using Ctrl.

You will learn the new controls in no time, and all your movements will become instinctive. And this is just the beginning as we are planning to roll out new commands to bring team coordination in battle to a whole new level!

notes.title: Transferring an Account from the CIS Server to the Europe
notes.content:
Dear players!

On April 4, we announced that all operations pertaining to Wargaming games in Russia and Belarus—operations for World of Tanks Blitz in particular—would be transferred to Lesta Games. This was the first step of a long-term strategy, resulting in the complete structural and financial divergence between the two companies. In terms of business and operation, World of Tanks Blitz and other products are currently managed by two independent companies: Lesta Games in Russia and Belarus, and Wargaming in all other countries.

The next important step will be the launch of a special account transfer campaign. Players who want to stay with Wargaming and continue playing via Steam will need to move from the CIS server to the Europe server.
The transfer will only be available for accounts linked to WG ID.

Account transfer is an important step: Each player on the CIS server will need to decide which server to continue playing on. Below you can find the key points of this process.
[olist]
 The CIS server will soon disappear from World of Tanks Blitz. Moreover, new players from Russia and Belarus will not be able to register a new World of Tanks Blitz account via Steam.
 New players from countries that were previously included in the CIS server (except for Russia and Belarus) will still be able to install World of Tanks Blitz via Steam and create an account. When registering, they will be offered the Europe server.
 If you already have an account on the CIS server, you will be given the option to transfer it to the Europe server and continue playing via Steam.
 If you don't want to transfer your account to the EU region (Europe server), unfortunately, you won't be able to continue playing via Steam.
[/olist]
High-quality services and player comfort have always been our top priority and remain so moving forward. Regardless of the server you choose to continue playing on, we will retain all progress and all in-game assets, as well as the key services that our players are used to.

We understand that this is a significant and momentous decision for our players, and we will do everything possible to make it as easy for everyone as possible.

Additional questions

HOW WILL THE ACCOUNTS BE TRANSFERRED?
Soon, when logging into the game, all players on the CIS server will see special information windows. Through them, we will ask some players to add an email or password to their account.
All Steam players on the CIS server will be given the option to transfer their account to the Europe server to continue playing WoT Blitz on their current account, while their data will continue to be processed by Wargaming.

HOW WILL MY ACCOUNT CHANGE AFTER THE TRANSFER?
If you choose to transfer your account to the Europe server, you will keep all vehicles, credits, gold, other resources, all assets in the Storage, all statistics, and even your nickname, if it's not used by another player. If your nickname is already taken, your new nickname on the Europe server will appear as follows: "Your_nickname_on_CIS_server_account_ID." The list of friends will also change, and you will no longer be a member of a clan.

I PLAY FROM BELARUS OR RUSSIA AND WOULD LIKE TO TRANSFER MY ACCOUNT TO THE EU REGION. WILL I BE ABLE TO MAKE IN-GAME PURCHASES AFTER THE ACCOUNT TRANSFER?
To find out if you can make purchases directly on Steam, check the payment methods available on the platform for your country or contact Steam Support.

CAN I MOVE MY EU/NA/ASIA ACCOUNT TO ANOTHER SERVER DURING THIS CAMPAIGN?
No, the campaign is intended for CIS players only. For other players on Steam, everything will remain unchanged.

WHAT CAN I DO IF I DON'T WANT TO TRANSFER MY ACCOUNT TO THE EUROPE SERVER?
Unfortunately, in that case, you will not be able to play World of Tanks via Steam using your CIS server account.

We will publish all the conditions and technical details closer to the launch of the account transfer campaign. Stay posted!

DETAILS
Restoring Sold Vehicles

You can now easily get back a sold Premium or Collector tank without leaving the game! Use the Restore Tank option in the vehicle carousel, on the tank stats screen in the Profile, or in the Store. You'll see a list of vehicles sold within the last 3 months, the date of sale, and the restoration price. You'll be able to restore vehicles sold before this period via Player Support. Please note that vehicles sold prior to Update 9.2 won't be on the list.

[code]The restoration price in gold is equal to the purchase price. The restoration price in credits is 10% higher than the purchase price. [/code]
Lower Resolution

We've reworked the Lower Resolution option to enhance gameplay comfort. Owners of less powerful devices will appreciate the change in the Static Lower Resolution: It now reduces the resolution of only landscape objects and tanks, while all elements of the battle interface remain clear.

Dynamic Lower Resolution will now ensure that the image is less blurry, improving your gaming experience. The tracking of high loads and FPS drops on iOS devices was improved: The option won't be activated unless necessary. In addition, Dynamic Lower Resolution is now available for PCs. Mac owners with high-resolution Retina displays will especially appreciate this since the option will be enabled by default.

Legendary Camos

The cartoonish Win Peaks for the AMX 30 1er prototype, the post-apocalyptic Burn for the K-91, and the jade Gongbi for the WZ-120-1G FT became available in the camo selection menu.

 IS-7: The Battle-hardened Legendary camo was improved. There is now more color differentiation from the tank's color gamma without the camo.
 A hint on how to use the Emergency track mechanic for the Yoh series tanks was added to the Brief Characteristics menu and vehicle preview screen.
 Rank upgrade progression was added to the second battle results screen. Sorting tanks by rank became available in the Profile statistics.
 Areas where vehicles became stuck were fixed, and some models of buildings and objects were adjusted for some maps.
 Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
 General bugs and client crashes were fixed.

He'd taken his best shots for the Blitztown Star. They'd be a huge success for the newspaper, and he'd enjoy fame and fortune. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/79a7257df4a3f45b57b14b1af0b62d1d0c80a54d.jpg

Happy citizens, bright flags fluttering in the breeze, the vehicle parade—nothing got past James' camera unnoticed. Then suddenly—familiar faces! His best friends, Ashley, Billy, and Hugh, invited him to go for a hike. They had important work to do: testing the new tank, the Ranger, in the wilderness! And maybe they'd even find the Yeti! It was an adventure not to be missed! James and his friends agreed to meet later at the entrance to the National Park as he needed to get back to photographing the festivities. Well, the best shots were still to come! 
Rewards for Winners
From June 30 to July 7, win in Tier IV–X vehicles. For each of your first 5 victories of the day, you'll get 3 Rollfilms. For a victorious battle to be counted, you need to score a certain amount of XP without Premium Account, boosters, or other modifiers:

Attempts to score a victory accumulate for days missed. So, if time allows, you can complete the event in one day.
Complete event stages using Rollfilms and get rewards: Premium Account, collectible items, Combat XP and Gold boosters, x3 XP certificates, and the American Eagle attachment!
For Collectors and Completionists
At Stages 3 and 8, you'll receive collectible items. The first item is a camera. According to the inscription, it belongs to James. The second item is a photograph of the most interesting tank for miles around, the T77, for the front page of the Blitztown Star. You can keep each collectible item as a souvenir or exchange it for 2,000 Free XP.

At Stage 9, you'll get the beautiful American Eagle attachment which can be installed on most American tanks. Feel its power, strength, and limitless freedom!

notes.title: Update 9.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=v3XJgXSmB6g;full][/previewyoutube]
Japanese Heavies
The Japanese Tech Tree has grown a new branch of six researchable heavy tanks. All of them boast strong armor and good mobility. Starting from Tier VII, tanks of the new branch feature unique equipment that improves either ground crossing capacity or vertical gun turn limits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/3f56cc6ebda54479c4b28ce422bef8e87d2842c8.jpg

Even More Realism
The Garage and Castilla map have received new graphics that will delight you with realistic materials and lighting. Trees sway from blast waves caused by shots and explosions, branches move apart as tanks drive through bushes… In three words, it's sheer beauty! The new dynamic resolution option will help you appreciate it to the fullest. Make sure to check out the system requirements and enjoy improvements without any drops in performance!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4be9be2a49dc9750ecc18b0b92f02f1ec84231d0.jpg

Reactions and Reports
We've been planning to rework the military honor functionality for a long time and finally decided to split it into Reactions and Reports. Reactions allow one to express their emotions after battle. They're like emojis or stickers in a messaging app. Reports are a whole different story. They're intended for reporting violations, such as unsporting conduct, provocative communication, or inactivity in battle. The new system will identify and impose just punishment on regular offenders based on your reports, so don't let them get away with misbehavior.

[previewyoutube=difdJhhuCZc;full][/previewyoutube]
Maximum Damage in the Profile
In the player profile, military honor will be replaced with information about maximum damage, such as the amount of damage, in which vehicle, and on which map the damage was dealt, as well as the date and time. 
 These stats don't include battles fought prior to Update 9.0 or battles in fun modes. 
New Aiming Mechanic
Following many open tests, research studies, and player surveys, we've reworked the aiming system. The reticle's appearance will remain the same while its behavior will significantly change. The reticle indicator will react better to the player's actions, move smoother relative to the terrain, and follow the target more accurately.

[previewyoutube=oW1kV_2PqFU;full][/previewyoutube]
Customization
During this Update, all attachments will be available in the Camouflage menu at a 50% discount!
The Moose Legendary camo for the Lansen C will also be added to the camo selection menu. A beast known for its fearlessness and unpredictability will appear on the turret, cold winter colors will cover the hull, and the tank's battle name will change to Lansen Moose.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/27ca82f727f306f6a82141d9866c5f77f9ab75aa.jpg

Balance Changes
STA-1

 The top engine's power-to-weight ratio was increased from 16.76 to 17.5 hp/t.
 Top speed was increased from 45 to 50 km/h.

T54E1 

 Magazine reload time was decreased from 17 to 16.5 s.
 The top engine's power-to-weight ratio was increased from 14.88 to 15.25 hp/t.
 Top speed was decreased from 50 to 45 km/h.
 The top gun's dispersion at 100 m was increased from 0.35 to 0.36 m.
 Changes to armor:
 From 110 to 127 mm for the upper glacis plate of the hull.
 From 108/88.9/50.8/127 to 118/96/70.8/167 mm for the turret collar front.
 From 127/127/63.5 to 147/147/72.5 for the oscillating turret front.
 From 127 to 237 mm for the gun's mantlet.
 From 127 to 107 mm for the commander's hatch.
40TP Habicha 
 For the top gun, reload time was increased from 8 to 9 s and dispersion at 100 m was increased from 0.38 to 0.39 m.

FCM 50 t

 Reload time was decreased from 7.2 to 6.5 s.
 Dispersion at 100 m was decreased from 0.36 to 0.35 m.

Improvements and Fixed Bugs

 The T-34/100, Škoda T 25, Object 252U with its Vigilant Legendary camo, as well as the American Eagle attachment were updated to the new graphics quality.
 A progress bar towards receiving a tank will now be shown when tapping the Charm icon or part of the certificate for a tank icon in the Storage. 
 Clan supply discounts on tanks will no longer be displayed in the Tech Tree. Instead, you can check the discount on the screen of the selected tank.
 Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
 General bugs and client crashes were fixed.

notes.title: Update 8.10
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4UWNNIw_ack;full][/previewyoutube]
New Operation Mechanics
It's now easier to complete Operations! You can complete missions within a week without losing progress for any days you may have missed. The number of levels has been adjusted too, decreasing from 80 to 60. However, the number of rewards remains mostly unchanged. Finally, a License that allows for Operations to be completed in a more straightforward manner has also been introduced.

Premium Shells Economy
We're continuing to refine the way the game's economy works. This time, we're making some adjustments that affect Premium shells. Their cost is now directly related to the tank's tier, as well as to their penetration and damage. Some shells purchased using gold and credits will go up in price slightly, while some will become cheaper. The cost of shells for Premium tanks will become less or remain the same.

Battle Results Improvement
After analyzing the feedback collected from players regarding the updated battle results screens, we decided to return Base XP. It will be displayed in all battle types except Rating Battles. By default, players' results are sorted by damage caused, but we also added the option to sort them by XP. Due to interface specifics, long nicknames may be displayed in a shortened form in battle results.

Legendary Camos
The mythical Qinglong for the Type 59, the daring Interceptor for the T-100 LT, the wild Rhino for the M48A2 Räumpanzer, the mighty Vigilant for the Object 252U, and the venomous Snakebite for the Krupp-Steyr Waffenträger became available in the camo selection menu.

Owners of the following three tanks will soon receive offers to buy new Legendary camos: the cartoonish Win Peaks for the AMX 30 1er prototype, the jade Gongbi for the WZ-120-1G FT, and the post-apocalyptic Burn for the K-91.

Improvements and Fixed Bugs

 The Vickers Mk. F, the Jagdpanzer E 100 with its Mighty Legendary camo and Spezialset attachment, as well as the Grille 15 with its Troublemaker and RA1DER Legendary camos received improved graphics.
 Mad Games: Tracks can no longer receive critical damage after the High-Octane Fuel modification expires.
 The bug where it was difficult to get a drowned enemy tank out of the crosshairs was fixed.
 The bug where the sound of tracks wasn't audible when driving over some objects was fixed.
 Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
 General bugs and client crashes were fixed.

notes.title: Subscribe for the T21!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/22e6a5e5d8b60a831315011e6d4411d347f86787.png

Do you want to add to your vehicle collection? Great! Simply enter the game every day and do your best in battles. Yep, you read that right! You'll get a tank for free for your mastery!

How Does It Work?
Go to the Store and get the free bundle "Subscription to the T21". Enter the game every day while the subscription is active and claim your reward: 10 parts of the certificate for the T21. On some days of the subscription, you'll also receive Orders. Complete them to get even more parts of the certificate! Don't miss a single day of the 10-day subscription to collect 200 parts of the certificate, combine them in your Storage, and make this American Collector light tank yours!

You can collect your rewards when you enter the game or in your Storage. Parts of the certificate and Orders are not added for days missed. Each Order is available for 24 hours and activates automatically. If you don't complete it within the allocated time, you'll receive 10 parts of the certificate.

What's the Tank Like?
The Т21 is quite a troublemaker. Its favorite tactic is to lurk in bushes until a target appears, take a nice clean shot, and change positions before the baffled enemy realizes where the attack came from. The T21 also loves giving its allies sightseeing tours from the hills. Thanks to its excellent view range, teammates can enjoy the most thrilling attraction—enemy vehicles. The good gun depression and elevation will help you catch any target with ease. Just don't forget to retreat to cover after firing. Lead your team to victory in the daring Т21!

notes.title: Rating Battles in February
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=1CyN6LCP5is;full][/previewyoutube]
Important updates are coming to Rating Battles! Rating points can now be earned even if you're defeated or lost even if you win. But the primary aspects remain unchanged. From February 5 to February 28, you can progress through the leagues and collect cool rewards, including parts of the certificate for the Lorraine Fearless. And a warm place among the top ten players might as well become yours!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/42bffc85bba730de76f7464ae92b6b2bf883aa84.jpg

Changes to Rating Calculations

Giving your best in battle is now more important than ever! Even if your team loses, your rating can still improve. At the same time, if you show a lack of initiative in battle, your rating will drop even if your team wins. Let's see how it works.

 The best player of the losing team can earn rating points as if they won. How is that possible? It's up to you and what you do in battle! The more active you are, the higher your chances of scoring points. Deal damage, spot foes, send enemies to their Garage, capture bases, and earn as much XP as possible in battles.
 Only one member of the losing team can earn rating points. 
 The players of the winning team who remained idle in battle will have the same rating they would have had if their team lost. Taking useful actions in battle will help you avoid such a fate.
 If there are several idle players on the winning team, each of them will receive a rating penalty.

Get the most out of each battle and get to the top of the rankings faster!

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=3c0UflPIQ4I;full][/previewyoutube]
According to the Chinese calendar, the Tiger—the symbol of the upcoming lunar year—favors the bold and decisive. And that's you! It's also believed that this noble predator always generously rewards such warriors. 

Which is true! From January 28 to February 7, participate in the Dance of the Tiger event, earn Coins for victories in Tier IV–X vehicles, and exchange them for cool rewards: Epic boosters, Premium Account, Lockbox Keys, an animated camouflage, a Legendary avatar, and the new Krupp-Steyr Waffenträger tank destroyer!

What Kind of Beast Is It?
Stealthy, extremely dangerous, and ideal for ambushes! The Steyr WT has everything an effective ambusher needs: small size and a powerful gun with a three-shell magazine and 660 HP of total damage. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/692c97ebf2edfa4d9b10c780d55834df3a127749.jpg

However, there's a nuance: the Steyr WT's weak armor is unforgiving for battlefield mistakes, which makes this tank destroyer an easy target for enemy HE shells. So you better make sure to stay out of the enemy's sight. Instead, find cover and reel off your magazine at unsuspecting opponents! Then rush to a new comfortable position thanks to the Steyr WT's ability to accelerate to 50 km/h. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/503d06798a0fe9a6cd956d96c36ef572331fbf6b.jpg

Good knowledge of maps is the key to success in the Krupp-Steyr Waffenträger. Shift quickly from cover to cover, provide fire support to allies, and feel at home among the top players by damage dealt!

The Soviet Tech Tree got a new branch of light tanks! In addition to an older tank that was moved there, it also received three new Tier VII, IX, and X vehicles. They're all fast, quick-firing, and well-concealed, while the Tier IX and X tanks feature a new spotting mechanic—Tracer Shells.
Balance Changes
This time, balance changes were made to Tier IX vehicles. For example, the Conqueror's turret will become stronger, the Škoda T 50'sdispersion and aiming time will decrease, and the T95 will be faster, but its reloading time will increase. 
Rating Battle Changes
Great play should be rewarded, so, starting February, in special cases, the most effective player of the defeated team will be able to get rating points as if they won. At the same time, an inactive player from the winning team will be treated as if they lost: Their rating can drop. You'll be able to learn more about these changes to Rating Battles in the February article.
Certificates for XP
We changed how sorting occurs in Storage, and now certificates for x3 and x5 XP are displayed at the top of the list. This way, it will be more convenient to keep track of them. Moreover, we fixed the issue in the Store where it wasn't always clear which tank in a bundle the certificate for bonus XP could be used for.

Owners of the following three tanks will soon receive offers to buy Legendary camos. These camos are the wild Rhino for the M48A2 Räumpanzer, the mighty Champion for the Object 252U, and the daring Interceptor for the T-100 LT.
Container for Ads
The Store will feature a container that you'll be able to open once a day by watching two ads. Its rewards may include icongoldpart parts of the certificate for gold, icongoldboost Gold boosters, iconshards Splinters, the exclusive Sparkling Spotlight camo, and the Panther/M10. At the same time, the usual feature of receiving gold by watching ads will not change. This container is only available for mobile device users.

Accumulative Discount for Training
The price of training for Regimental School (up to 75%) or Tank Academy (up to 100%) used to be fixed and didn't depend on your level of mastery. Now it decreases as your crew mastery grows. The less left until 75%, the cheaper the training for credits. The less left until 100%, the cheaper the training for gold.
 These discounts are combined with other temporary discounts for crew training.   
Joining Light and Medium Tanks
It's time to make changes to the way the matchmaker selects vehicles for battles. Light and medium tanks used to have different values in the matchmaker. So there were rarely cases when teams were unequal. As the way to play medium and light tanks is more similar, the matchmaker will consider them to be the same type. This means it will strive to make the ratio of light and medium tanks, as well as other vehicles, the same for both teams.

Now it's easier to monitor your tank's key parameter! The indicator became bigger, its color changes from green to red, and the amount of HP lost is displayed with a visual effect. When penetrated, the indicator blinks.

notes.title: The LT-432: A Soviet UFO
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=lDdO2J8RMEk;full][/previewyoutube]
Hahaha, some enemies really believe that an unidentified flying object is chasing them. That's because it's not a tank, but rather a saucer with a turret! Although it can't fly, so technically it's more of a UMO—an unidentified moving object. If only opponents knew how this tank was created...

Fighting in this tank is sheer fun. Not fighting can be just as fun! First, take a detour and race at 70 km/h along the edges. Then appear behind the enemy and... boom, bam! Fire some shots and withdraw on the double! Once the battle is finished, it's time to count credits. Consider getting a bookkeeper for this.

Containers that may include the LT-432 or other rewards will be available in the in-game Store until October 29. Each container has an LT-432 Charm. Collect 25 Charms and get the tank!
The LT-432 Is Somewhere Hereabouts...

But where exactly? That's a good question! This new light tank is lightning fast and comes equipped with a gun boasting high single-shot damage. Its road-hugging hull is covered with thin, yet effectively sloped, armor. Its concealment parameters make many tank destroyers blush in embarrassment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0e72c0863685650ab6b4aa061613f531db4615cb.jpg

The LT-432 rides perfectly on the straight. The speedometer shows 40 km/h in just 3-4 seconds. A few seconds more and the tank is already dashing at 60 km/h. The 70 km/h top speed can rarely be reached without provisions and equipment. But once applied, this value is quite reachable on the straight.

This new tank can move quickly not just forwards but backwards. The LT-432's reverse speed reaches 30 km/h! Making an enemy's life a nightmare by raking them with fire from unexpected positions will be especially comfortable. By the time the enemy can aim, the LT-432 will have already vanished into thin air!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/9d0a36ecce91ee1510c69afad816380c88a0ce77.jpg

Although this newbie is inferior to most opponents in maneuverability, it is anything but clumsy. The LT-432 can whiz around the battlefield and spin around hefty tank destroyers. Circling more mobile foes won't be as easy since the tank noticeably loses speed when traversing.

Like any light tank, the LT-432 is nominally armored. Its well-angled frontal armor and sloped turret will only protect against the occasional shot. At best, sidescraping can protect against Tier VII light tanks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6b16caf023ff70cc292004dafd1c9f47d4031dff.jpg

To survive, the LT-432 should take advantage of its speed, low silhouette, and good concealment:

 The speed will help it quickly take and change positions, as well as escape enemy fire.
 The low silhouette will enable it to fire and spot enemies from behind cover where only its small, hard-to-hit turret will be exposed to opponents.
 The good concealment will naturally ensure the tank remains unspotted. So long as the LT-432 doesn't shoot, it can hardly be noticed even on the move. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b7c1555657411b7bb1066ded59110d0afca2ad18.jpg

Due to small depression and elevation angles, this tank isn't suitable for positional combat among terrain irregularities. That's why the best spots for the LT-432 are flat areas with low cover.

When playing on open maps, carefully spot enemy maneuvers at the beginning of a battle and take a detour behind your team's lines in case an enemy scout breaks through. By that time, the main encounters will have started, which means it's time to see where the LT-432 will cause the most damage.

There's no point in looking for one-on-one clashes. An enemy already engaged in firefights is the best gift for the LT-432.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/406b4ae462ddf41b6aa08b4a1fbf8e3f1b124f1b.jpg

Roll forward, shoot the sides and rear, deal 280 HP of damage, and quickly retreat to cover to wait out the 9-second reload time. Did an enemy aim its gun at your position? Perfect! Just sit back and allow your allies to inflict damage. Or rush forward to another point to pull the same trick again.

It's no good sniping from TD positions. The 175 mm of penetration is more than enough to damage the sides, but it's hardly enough to penetrate a Tier VIII opponent from the front. Accurately aiming at the enemy's weak spots isn't the tank's strong point as well.

If you manage to preserve at least half of your HP by the end of the battle (there, there, this comes with experience!), you can hunt down isolated enemies. Slow tank destroyers and huge German heavies are perfect victims to be "snatched" to the Garage. It's quite fun to get close to some VK 100.01 (P), which is simply unable to hit such a tank with a low silhouette. But beware of ramming!

notes.title: Operation Landship
notes.content:
Operation Landship starts in World of Tanks Blitz. Drive your tracked, steel giant into battle and make your enemies beat a hasty retreat! Succeed in battles and receive not only glory, but also great rewards including resources, camos, themed avatars, and the Dreadnought! 

To positions!

How to Get Rewards?

To participate in the event, you'll need a Tier III vehicle or higher. 

The Operation includes two reward progressions, each consisting of 80 levels. The upper progression is available to regular Pass owners. In other words, all players. The lower progression is only available to Premium Pass holders. Increase the Level of your Pass to get rewards. To do so, complete missions and earn Helmets: 10 Helmets = 1 level.

Although your Level increases automatically, you will need to collect your rewards manually.

You can earn up to 30 Helmets per day. Premium Pass owners enjoy access to an additional daily mission that provides an extra 10 Helmets. With Premium Pass, you can earn 40 Helmets a day and unlock 4 levels with rewards. Also, Premium Pass lets you instantly increase your Level using gold.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/cce88e57af332d83223eb7a2559e67db802d77ae.jpg
